start.speaker: Aldric
start.text: Steel needs seeing to? I upgrade, I repair. Gold only. I stopped taking promises the year the promises stopped arriving.

choices.text: You keep a fire. I thought that was forbidden.
You were at the muster, then.
The fortress held two winters without a hearth.
What do you make of the Ledger?
You have been at this anvil a long time.

fire.speaker: Aldric
fire.text: The order was no fires. Cold keeps what warmth spends — that was the reasoning, and it was good reasoning, and I have read what came of it. I keep a fire.

muster.speaker: Aldric
muster.text: I made eleven of the blades he calls names for. He has been calling them a long time. I would rather he stopped, and I would not say so where he can hear it.

cold.speaker: Aldric
cold.text: Two winters to prove a point about thrift. The plate learned to be enough. The men in it did not get the chance to learn anything.

ledger.speaker: Aldric
ledger.text: A ledger is only a list of things somebody meant to settle. I have one myself. It is shorter than the Chapter's and I intend to close it.

aldric_arc.speaker: Aldric
aldric_arc.text: Long enough to have taught someone. He went down with the second party and I made his kit myself. Every strap on it was mine. If you want the apprenticeship, it is yours, and I will not pretend it is an honour.
